bio: Adjunct Professor of Nutrition Nutrition, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Nutrition Teresa Fung, ScD, RD, is an Adjunct Professor of Nutrition at the Harvard TH Chan School of Public Health. As a nutritional epidemiologist, her work focused on examining the associations between various measures of diet quality and diabetes, cardiovascular disease, cancer, weight change, geriatric fractures, and geriatric frailty. She completed a BS and MS in nutrition at Cornell University, and a dual Doctor of Science in epidemiology and nutrition at the Harvard TH Chan School of Public Health. She is also a Registered Dietitian. Currently, she is an Associate Editor for the Journal of Nutrition, a member of the Editorial Board for the Journal of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, and was a member of the 2025-2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans Scientific Advisory Committee.
